anchorConvention: edge coordinates: pixel centre = x + 0.5; root = feet centre at the bottom edge of the lowest solid row (alpha >= 128, lowest 4 rows); head = centre of the top 4 solid rows at the top edge; groundContact = root; hairAnchor = centre of the topmost solid row (scalp top) at its top edge; outfitAnchor = centre of the first row with >= 4 neckline-coloured px (#ffffff/#cbdbfc) at its top edge; mirrored x' = frameWidth - x
layerRole: starter-outfit character reference (flattened skin + clothing; not a reusable under-clothing body layer)

provenance.construction: approved male bald base walk (latest rev) + middle-part hair layer (over)
